name: Zingly agentic voice AI
summary: Pegasus Airlines' innovation lab has invested in Zingly.ai and made it a design partner (LARA, October 20). The first guest service use case is live: the AI answers inbound calls in natural conversation, connects to Pegasus's existing systems to resolve the request during the call, and hands the caller to a human agent with the full conversation context when needed. The roadmap runs to mid-2027 and targets the top 10 guest service use cases, starting in Turkish.

whyItMatters: Every call that ends with the change made, instead of a callback, saves agent time and keeps a booking or ancillary sale from walking away. The number to ask any voice AI vendor for is the share of calls resolved without a handoff, measured on your own top call types.
